judgments.justification: Says it "outperformed it on five of the six datasets"; actually higher on all six (Lumley-Metab 69.8 vs 69.5 is still higher).
"higher average test ROC-AUC than Quintrell-MP (79.4 vs 78.4)" matches.
Says Avonlea higher on five of six except Hollin-Sol; actually Larchmont is higher on both Hollin-Sol and Jessamine-Kin (80.9 vs 81.4), so four lower.
"removing ring-aware pooling reduced... to 78.7, removing distance features to 78.9, and removing both to 78.0" matches.
No mention of absence of statistical tests or significance.
Reports slightly larger/slower than Quintrell, far more efficient than Avonlea, no pretraining; average gap to Avonlea given elsewhere (80.0 vs 79.4).
Reports higher average but claims wins on only five of six datasets, not all six.
Notes small margin on Lumley-Metab but frames it as not an outperformance, and omits Ivybridge-Tox's 0.3 margin.
